description: Test cgroupv1 controllers are mounted in containers
name: cgroups-mount-v1

almalinux-10.script:
machine.wait_for_osctl_pool("tank")
machine.wait_until_online

testct = get_container_id

machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct new --distribution almalinux --version 10 #{testct}",
  "osctl ct unset start-menu #{testct}",
  "osctl ct start #{testct}",
)

# Give the container some time to start, as cgroups are mounted by the init
# system
sleep(10)

_, output = machine.succeeds("osctl ct exec #{testct} cat /proc/mounts")

controllers = %w(
  cpu,cpuacct
  cpuset
  devices
  freezer
  hugetlb
  memory
  net_cls,net_prio
  perf_event
  pids
  rdma
  systemd
)

controllers.each do |c|
  if /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/#{c} cgroup ")}/ !~ output
    fail "#{c} not mounted"
  end
end

# unified cgroup is not mounted on CentOS/Alma/Rocky 7 and 8
check_unified =
  if ("almalinux" == "centos" && %w(7).include?("10")) \
      || ("almalinux" == "almalinux" && "10" == "8") \
      || ("almalinux" == "rocky" && "10" == "8")
    false
  else
    true
  end

if check_unified && /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/unified cgroup2 ")}/ !~ output
  fail "unified cgroup not mounted"
end

machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct del -f --prune #{testct}",
  "osctl repository images prune"
)

_, output = machine.succeeds("osctl ct exec #{testct} cat /proc/mounts")

controllers = %w(
  cpu,cpuacct
  cpuset
  devices
  freezer
  hugetlb
  memory
  net_cls,net_prio
  perf_event
  pids
  rdma
  systemd
)

controllers.each do |c|
  if /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/#{c} cgroup ")}/ !~ output
    fail "#{c} not mounted"
  end
end

# unified cgroup is not mounted on CentOS/Alma/Rocky 7 and 8
check_unified =
  if ("ubuntu" == "centos" && %w(7).include?("22.04")) \
      || ("ubuntu" == "almalinux" && "22.04" == "8") \
      || ("ubuntu" == "rocky" && "22.04" == "8")
    false
  else
    true
  end

if check_unified && /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/unified cgroup2 ")}/ !~ output
  fail "unified cgroup not mounted"
end

machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct del -f --prune #{testct}",
  "osctl repository images prune"
)

ubuntu-24.04.script:
machine.wait_for_osctl_pool("tank")
machine.wait_until_online

testct = get_container_id

machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct new --distribution ubuntu --version 24.04 #{testct}",
  "osctl ct unset start-menu #{testct}",
  "osctl ct start #{testct}",
)

# Give the container some time to start, as cgroups are mounted by the init
# system
sleep(10)

_, output = machine.succeeds("osctl ct exec #{testct} cat /proc/mounts")

controllers = %w(
  cpu,cpuacct
  cpuset
  devices
  freezer
  hugetlb
  memory
  net_cls,net_prio
  perf_event
  pids
  rdma
  systemd
)

controllers.each do |c|
  if /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/#{c} cgroup ")}/ !~ output
    fail "#{c} not mounted"
  end
end

# unified cgroup is not mounted on CentOS/Alma/Rocky 7 and 8
check_unified =
  if ("ubuntu" == "centos" && %w(7).include?("24.04")) \
      || ("ubuntu" == "almalinux" && "24.04" == "8") \
      || ("ubuntu" == "rocky" && "24.04" == "8")
    false
  else
    true
  end

if check_unified && /^\w+ #{Regexp.escape("/sys/fs/cgroup/unified cgroup2 ")}/ !~ output
  fail "unified cgroup not mounted"
end

machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct del -f --prune #{testct}",
  "osctl repository images prune"
)
